comment: Paths whose value a run of one release does not hold constant (ADR-0028). A value at one of these paths becomes the token #volatile before a comparison or a hash. Each entry has a measured example from the two baseline exports of SPT 4.1.6, which differ in 13 files; a path that no entry covers stays a difference, so a new volatile field shows up as a warning in the first run. The generated ids of an assort are not listed here: they are renumbered by position (decision 3), not replaced by a token.

entries.evidence: 10 of 12 traders: 1792518932 in one run, 1792473833 in the next. The restock clock.
lighthouse and woods: 0 in one run, 35 in the next. The boss event rotates per boot.
